title: Two Patterns for Consistency
use_cases: Implement when developing long-form text generation applications that require persistent story elements
Configure when managing excessive conversation history to prevent model overflow
Use when maintaining character integrity and 'global consistency' across multiple API calls
Apply when building features that require sequential 'narrative flow' and awareness of previous events
content:
This is the part where most LLM integrations fail. They treat every API call like a blank slate, or worse, they try to stuff the entire conversation history into the context window until the model chokes.

To make the Convert Screenplay feature work, we had to solve two specific problems: Global Consistency (remembering that the protagonist is now an alien named Zeus) and Narrative Flow (remembering that the building just exploded).

We solved this using two patterns that you can steal for almost any long-form generation app.
